summary: The filing reports the results of Arcutis Biotherapeutics' 2026 annual meeting of stockholders on June 5, 2026. Stockholders voted on three proposals: election of three Class III directors; ratification of Ernst & Young as independent auditor; and non-binding advisory approval of named executive officer compensation. All proposals passed. The filing also describes amendments to the non-employee director compensation program, effective as of the meeting. This is a routine current report on shareholder votes and a director compensation program change, not a special situation.
